ambiguity_rule: A record with exact tokens in more than one high-level action stratum is AMBIGUOUS_MULTIPLE_STRATA and contributes to no single-action semantic admission.
construct_rule: Even exact classified tokens are provider record/link semantics only. They bind no R7 owner-algebra field without the protocol owner/delegation, rights, completeness, and exhaustiveness gates.
directionality_rule: Preserve exact provider token and direction. In/Of, corrected/forward, and retracted/forward are never collapsed into an owner-authorized operation.

source_evidence.note: Rules were frozen from provider schemas/documentation before aggregate action values from the V2 pool were opened.

unknown_rule: Any token outside the frozen map is counted as OTHER_OR_CANNOT_CHECK. Absence is CANNOT_CHECK, not a negative action.
